name: The Silo Cape Town
positioning: The Silo Hotel, a Royal Portfolio hotel set in a 1924 grain silo building above the V&A Waterfront, occupying six floors above the Zeitz Museum of Contemporary Art Africa, with pillowed-glass windows framing Table Mountain and the harbour
best_for: Art and design lovers who want to stay above Zeitz MOCAA
Travelers who want a V&A Waterfront base with Table Mountain and harbour views
Families who want a two-bedroom duplex suite with a kids' room

facts.text: The hotel is perched above the V&A Waterfront in Cape Town.
The hotel occupies six floors above the Zeitz Museum of Contemporary Art Africa (MOCAA).
The hotel and the museum share a historic grain silo building built in 1924; the hotel is in its grain elevator portion.
The building's exterior was designed by Thomas Heatherwick of the London-based Heatherwick Studio.
The hotel's art collection, selected by Royal Portfolio owner Liz Biden, features emerging and eminent African contemporary artists.
The two-bedroom Royal Suites have views of Table Mountain, the Atlantic Ocean and Robben Island.
The Penthouse is on the top floor.
The double-storey Duplex Suites each have a balcony and a lounge.
The double-storey, two-bedroom Family Duplex Suites have a smaller kids' room.
The Silo Spa is on the hotel's fourth floor and has five treatment rooms, two of which can be made into a couple's room.
The spa has a fitness centre, a sauna and a manicure and pedicure area, and its therapists use products including Ling and Black Pearl.
Royal Tea is served at The Granary Cafe.

highlights.text: The hotel is defined by its pillowed-glass windows, with panoramic views from Table Mountain to the Table Bay harbour.
The Deluxe Superior Suites look out on the harbour and Table Mountain through geometric windows 18 feet tall.
The hotel has a heated rooftop swimming pool.
The Silo Rooftop is the highest point in the V&A Waterfront, with panoramic ocean and city views.
Guided tours of Zeitz MOCAA can be arranged with the hotel concierge.

considerations.text: Dining at the hotel is by prior reservation only.
Check-in is at 2pm and check-out is at 11am.
WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing that reflects the hotel's premium positioning.
